name: branding-blue-industrial-logo-icons-and-catalog-phone
title: Blue metal-supplier logo, three line icons and a hand holding the catalogue
whatItIs: A pale board with a large logo card (striped blue monogram, black and blue split wordmark, tagline), three dark-blue rounded tiles with white line icons for laser cutting, pipe and grinder, and a blue panel showing a hand holding a phone with a category list.
whatItMeans: Reliable and practical; simple line icons make technical services understandable.
techniques: Show the logo, icon set and application in a tidy tile grid.
Draw service icons in white line on deep blue rounded squares.
Present the mobile catalogue held in a hand on a solid blue field.
Split a wordmark into black and blue parts.

vocabulary.definition: A name coloured in two parts.
A pictogram on a rounded square.
A tile showing the brand in use.
